description: R4 redirection tie (Opus OO): Rage Powder (Ariados) and Follow Me (Clefable) at equal Speed 72 with Ariados leading in p2a, so it switched in first. Showdown's priorityEvent sorts the RedirectTarget handlers with compareRedirectOrder (priority, Speed, then the holders' abilityState.effectOrder; a stable sort, no tie shuffle): the holder whose ability state started first wins, whichever move it used and whoever moved first. Garchomp's Dragon Claw aimed at Clefable goes to Ariados.
